name: sakuramedia-skill-builder
author: SakuraMedia
description: 根据当前后端真实的 API 端点，规划并生成新的 SakuraMedia Agent skill：列出端点与副作用分级、产出 skill 骨架、检查写操作是否都有用户确认门禁。
description_en: Plan and scaffold new SakuraMedia agent skills from the backend's real endpoints: list endpoints with a side-effect classification, generate a skill skeleton, and verify every write command is gated behind user confirmation.
